property_summary: For any target that reverts on receiving value, the reference contract's sendMoney call will itself revert (call fails) and thus not report success, whereas the mutant inverts the require causing sendMoney to succeed only when the external call succeeds — so for some inputs the mutant's observable success/failure differs from the reference.
change_summary: Invert the require so the call is required to fail; if call succeeds, the transaction reverts, changing whether funds are transferred and thus observable state.
